definitions.gloss: front side; front part; the front
definitions.explanation: The front-facing part or side of an object, building, body, or area. Used to specify spatial orientation.

examples.japanese: {前側|まえがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前側|まえがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入口|いりぐち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The entrance is on the front side of the building.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{前側|まえがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ポケット→ポケット：02964_poketto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦{付|つ}いている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: This shirt has two pockets on the front.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ (front) and ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ (side). Part of a set of directional compounds using ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧: ⟦{後|うし}ろ{側|がわ}→後ろ側：20172_ushirogawa⟧ (back side), ⟦{右側|みぎがわ}→右側：24189_migigawa⟧ (right side), ⟦{左側|ひだりがわ}→左側：22836_hidarigawa⟧ (left side), ⟦{片側|かたがわ}→片側：20150_katagawa⟧ (one side).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前側|まえがわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧ — front seat
- {前側|まえがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ — to go around to the front
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前側|まえがわ} — the front of the body

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {前面|ぜんめん} — front surface (more formal)
- ⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧ — the front, directly facing
- ⟦{後|うし}ろ{側|がわ}→後ろ側：20172_ushirogawa⟧ — back side (antonym)
